verdict.rationale: New Relic documents official SDKs. The New Relic SDK components and the nr1 CLI are used to build New Relic apps (create Nerdpacks, serve them locally). APM agents for Go, Java, .NET, Node.js, PHP, Python and Ruby can also be enabled 'as an SDK' for instrumentation, alongside OpenTelemetry support. Missing for 10: official client SDKs for the NerdGraph/data APIs (only a raw GraphQL API and explorer are evidenced, and no OpenAPI spec was found), in-depth SDK reference coverage, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK developer experience.
